harness-security: AUDITED 2026-09-28. BACKLOG ITEM CLEARED. [3 FINDINGS REPORTED]
  Literal facts in cache/aws_agentcore_harness_iam_permissions.txt. Headlines:
  * additionalParams passed through "unchanged... does not validate, filter, or restrict."
    LiteLLM aws_bedrock_runtime_endpoint reroutes the SIGNED request incl. SigV4 signature
    and session credentials. OpenAI extra_headers overrides the Authorization header.
    aws_role_name attempts sts:AssumeRole. modelId/apiBase redirect the provider.
  * *** skills CAN BE OVERRIDDEN PER InvokeHarness CALL, fetched from S3/Git at invocation
    time, "treats all skill content as trusted input", never inspected. ***
  * IAM table = 14 rows. InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell is the ONLY invoke API not also
    requiring InvokeAgentRuntime. New ARN types: harness/<id> and
    harness/<id>/harness-endpoint/<name>.
  * SigV4 does NOT propagate per-user identity downstream; Token Vault per-user scoping is
    JWT-inbound ONLY. "planned for a future release."
  * DOES exist server-side: harness rejects a toolUse block in the FINAL message. Non-harness
    AgentCore Runtime has "no server-side protection" for the same thing.
  * The AWS sample execution role (created AUTOMATICALLY by the AgentCore CLI) grants
    bedrock:InvokeModel on foundation-model/* across all regions + all account Bedrock.
harness-operations: AUDITED 2026-09-28. BACKLOG ITEM CLEARED. [1 FINDING REPORTED]
  Literal facts in cache/aws_agentcore_harness_operations.txt. Headlines:
  * *** NO harness CloudTrail resource type. Everything is AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime.
    There is NO `InvokeHarness` CLOUDTRAIL EVENT NAME — data plane logs as
    InvokeAgentRuntime / InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand / InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell. ***
  * resources.ARN = harness ARN on control plane, RUNTIME ARN on data plane. The two halves
    do not join without an externally built harness->runtime map.
  * Traces require Transaction Search enabled in CloudWatch, ONE-TIME PER ACCOUNT. Off by
    default => a harness can run with zero trace data and no error.
  * Limits: maxIterations 75 / timeoutSeconds 3600 / maxTokens none / idleRuntimeSession
    Timeout 900 / maxLifetime 28800. First three are OVERRIDABLE PER INVOCATION.
  * Harness tags propagate to managed Runtime, Runtime endpoint and managed Memory only.
UNAUDITED harness subpages REMAINING: harness-versioning, harness-export, harness-memory,
  harness-environment, harness-models, harness-get-started#api-documentation. Lower
  priority than the two cleared today but harness-versioning + harness-export are next.
